elements.text: Pilot's failure to identify and arrest the helicopter's descent
Lack of an operable radar altimeter in the helicopter
Safety Board issued Safety Recommendations A-07-111 through -112 relating to radar altimeters in HEMS operations
Controller did not continuously monitor radar data
Controller did not make further attempts to contact the flight by radio after receiving no response
Controller did not notice that radar data for the flight ceased
Adoption of the report by the National Transportation Safety Board
Concurring statement filed by Member Higgins
